name: device/hopper_sm90a
doc: the Hopper device of compute capability 9.0 (the build's sm_90a); its values are csrc/fsla/src/common/hardware.json's arch.sm_90a, which tests/unit/test_hardware_registry.py holds equal

cc.validated_by: csrc/fsla/src/common/select.cu admit: the driver's compute capability must be a tabulated one at the first call on a device

regs_per_sm.validated_by: csrc/fsla/src/common/select.cu admit: the table's value must equal prop.regsPerMultiprocessor at the first call on a device

smem_per_sm.validated_by: csrc/fsla/src/common/select.cu admit: the table's value must equal cudaDevAttrMaxSharedMemoryPerMultiprocessor at the first call on a device

smem_per_cta_optin.validated_by: csrc/fsla/src/common/select.cu admit: the table's value must equal cudaDevAttrMaxSharedMemoryPerBlockOptin at the first call on a device

max_threads_per_sm.validated_by: csrc/fsla/src/common/select.cu admit: the table's value must equal prop.maxThreadsPerMultiProcessor at the first call on a device

tensor.documented_by: csrc/fsla/src/common/hardware.json arch.sm_90a.rates.mma: the H100 whitepaper's tensor-core rates

instructions.documented_by: csrc/fsla/src/common/hardware.json arch.sm_90a.caps, each cap's page in docs/internals/common/arch_caps.md
